correctness.rationale: Read complete frozen proof. Every cubic edge sees four other edges, forcing two red and two blue. For red uv the incident red degrees sum to four, for blue uv sum to two. Therefore edges cannot join degree profile classes {0,2} and {1,3}; connectedness forces one class. Types 0 or 3 form the unique recoverable efficient dominating set with its incident edges one named colour. Conversely a perfect 1-code induces exactly two globally swapped assignments and both satisfy the local split. Thus b2=2p, and a cubic dominating set has at least n/4 vertices with equality exactly when its disjoint size-four closed neighborhoods partition V. The prism recurrence forces 4|m and four codes, hence eight named colourings. General validity from proof, not finite checks.
residual_risks: Connectedness essential; disconnected case has independent component colour orientations.
The fixed graph gamma criterion does not determine p(G) globally.
